title: fix(service-settings): move the storage, knowledge and AI warnings into info_banner rows
body:
Fixes #23839
Clause-②: no — the bundles fill a slot the spec already declares, and no setting's key, value, default or save behaviour changes. Measured: the package's built `dist/index.d.ts` and `dist/index.d.cts` are byte-identical at the base and at this head.

## Landing gate: keep this PR draft

This PR stays draft until objectstack's `.objectui-sha` (now `daeb77fc84`) carries objectstack-ai/objectui#12671's banner reader, because until then the console draws each banner's English literal and zh-CN, ja-JP and es-ES admins would lose the translated warnings they read today.

## What changes

Four warnings were sentences inside ordinary strings, each starting with a hand-typed warning glyph, so the admin read them as one more sentence of the page subtitle or of a toggle's help. Each one is now an `info_banner` row with `bannerSeverity: 'warning'`, an `id`, a short `label` (its title) and `bannerText`. It sits in the section it concerns, directly under the field it warns about:

| Namespace | Banner `id` | Section, position | Was inside |
|---|---|---|---|
| `storage` | `adapter_switch_warning` | Backend, under the Adapter select | the namespace `description` |
| `knowledge` | `adapter_switch_warning` | Backend, under the Adapter select | the namespace `description` |
| `knowledge` | `enforce_rls_warning` | Permissions, under the Enforce RLS on search toggle | the `enforce_rls` help (`description`) |
| `ai` | `log_prompts_warning` | Observability, under the Log full prompts toggle | the `log_prompts` help (`description`) |

Each string keeps its non-warning text:

- storage keeps "Backend used for attachments, exports, and user uploads."
- knowledge keeps "Vector-store backend for RAG / knowledge sources." and also the sentence after the warning, "The embedder is configured separately under AI."
- `enforce_rls` keeps "Re-check every hit against the caller's record-level permissions via IDataEngine."
- `log_prompts` keeps "Include rendered prompts (not just metadata) in trace rows."

`feature-flags.manifest.ts` is unchanged: its `beta_notice` banner already had an `id`.

### Translations

In the `en`, `zh-CN`, `ja-JP` and `es-ES` bundles, each warning sentence left the bundle's `description` / `help` copy and now sits under `settings.NAMESPACE.banners.BANNER_ID.{title,text}`, the slot PR #23886 declared. The translated sentences are the ones each bundle already carried, moved without the glyph and not re-translated. Each banner has a new short title in every locale:

| Banner | en | zh-CN | ja-JP | es-ES |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `storage.adapter_switch_warning` | Existing files are not migrated | 已有文件不会迁移 | 既存ファイルは移行されません | Los archivos existentes no se migran |
| `knowledge.adapter_switch_warning` | Existing indices are not migrated | 已有索引不会迁移 | 既存のインデックスは移行されません | Los índices existentes no se migran |
| `knowledge.enforce_rls_warning` | Leave RLS on in production | 生产环境请保持开启 | 本番環境では有効のままにしてください | Mantenlo activado en producción |
| `ai.log_prompts_warning` | Prompts may contain PII | Prompt 可能含有 PII | PII 漏えいの可能性 | Los prompts pueden contener PII |
| `feature_flags.beta_notice` | Heads up | 注意 | ご注意ください | Atención |

The Feature Flags `beta_notice` banner gained copies in all four bundles, since the coverage test now requires them.

### Pins

- `settings-translation-coverage.test.ts` covers banners in both directions. Every `info_banner` `id` needs a `title` and a `text` in zh-CN, ja-JP and es-ES. A banner with no `id` is reported, because no locale can address it. No locale (en included) may carry a banner id the manifest does not declare.
- The same file sweeps every manifest's `description`, `helpText` and specifier help, and every locale's `description`, group `description` and key `help`: none may contain the warning glyph. Each sweep also asserts it read more than 50 strings, so it cannot pass on an empty set.
- `storage.manifest.test.ts`, `knowledge.manifest.test.ts` and `ai.manifest.test.ts` each pin three things: the exact set of `info_banner` ids with `bannerSeverity: 'warning'`; that each banner has a label and a body and sits in its section directly under its field; and that the glyph appears nowhere in the serialized manifest.

## Evidence (head `c396797fd5`)

- **Package suite:** `pnpm --filter @objectstack/service-settings exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2` gave `Test Files 47 passed (47)`, `Tests 845 passed (845)`. `pnpm --filter @objectstack/service-settings typecheck` (`tsc --noEmit`) exited 0, and `--listFiles` shows all four edited test files in the program.
- **Runtime probe** (one-off, not committed): `PlatformTranslationDataSchema.safeParse` on each shipped bundle gave `success=true` for en, zh-CN, ja-JP and es-ES. Every pair of the 5 banners and 4 locales (20 in all) resolved through `resolveSettingsBannerTitle` / `resolveSettingsBannerText` from the bundle; none fell back to the manifest literal.
- **Ablations** were run through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` in wrap mode, on the four test files (105 tests), with the tests reading `src` by relative import, so no `dist` was involved. Each restore was proven: blob equals HEAD, and `git diff HEAD` was empty.

  | Mutation | Red |
  |---|---|
  | rename the zh-CN storage banner key `adapter_switch_warning` to `adapter_switch_warnin` | `zh-CN covers settings.storage` (missing `banner:adapter_switch_warning.title`, `.text`) and `zh-CN carries no copy for a group, key or banner no manifest declares` (`storage.banner:adapter_switch_warnin`), 2 failed |
  | put the glyph back into the storage manifest `description` | the storage pin `carries the warning glyph nowhere` and the sweep (`storage.description`), 2 failed |
  | set `log_prompts_warning` to `bannerSeverity: 'info'` | the AI pin `declares it as a warning-severity info_banner`, 1 failed |
  | put the glyph back into the ja-JP `log_prompts` help | `ja-JP carries the warning glyph in no description or help copy` (`ai.keys.log_prompts.help`), 1 failed |

- **Declaration closure:** the seven edited source files were put back to the base in the working tree only, the package was rebuilt, and then the files were restored to HEAD (blob proof) and rebuilt again. `dist/index.d.ts` and `dist/index.d.cts` are byte-identical (md5 `68d6b431c4c7fe099f1fe841af3ac690` both sides). Every edited export is declared with a named type (`SettingsManifest`, `PlatformTranslationData`, `PlatformTranslationBundle`).
- **Local gates:** `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` derived 63 commands at `c396797fd5`. 62 exited 0. `pnpm check:dual-build-cjs-loads` exited 3 with `PREREQUISITE NOT MET` (it needs every package's `dist`), so it is NOT MEASURED locally and is left to CI. `--ran` reconciliation: `63 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 62 run, 1 NOT-MEASURED`, 0 unrun.

## Acceptance notes

- **The en banner text mirrors the manifest.** For the two knowledge banners, the `en` text is the manifest's full sentence, because the `en` bundle's header says it mirrors the manifest literals. The old `en` copy carried shortened warnings ("Switching adapter does NOT migrate existing indices."; "Disabling skips the platform's unique safeguard."), so English admins now read the full sentence the manifest always had. ja-JP and es-ES had translated the shortened copies, and those moved as they were.
- **Pre-existing drift, left as found:** the `en` and translated knowledge descriptions omit "The embedder is configured separately under AI.", and the `enforce_rls` help in en, ja-JP and es-ES omits "via IDataEngine". Both differences predate this PR, and only the warning sentence was removed here.
- **The glyph is gone from the banner text as well;** `bannerSeverity` is now the only warning marker. At the pin `daeb77fc84`, the console draws every non-`error` severity in the default Alert variant with an Info icon, and renders `bannerText` as plain text. Both renderer findings belong to objectstack-ai/objectui#12610's owner and are not re-filed here. Until that change lands, these banners look like info callouts. Each is still its own titled callout under its field.
- `origin/main` advanced to `8f4260fe66` while this ran. None of those commits touches `packages/services/service-settings` or `packages/spec/src/system`, so the branch was not merged again before opening.
